title: Bind enrichment responses to request UUID order
acceptance: An out-of-order cache-probe regression proves each fetched response updates its originating UUID, including mixed hits and invalid rows.

title: Restrict enrichment candidate reads to a captured project
acceptance: Two-project fixture proves only the captured project's unenriched cards enter the batch.

title: Assign the front project ID to synthesized DFC backs
acceptance: Enriching a DFC creates a back with exactly its front projectId and valid reciprocal links.

title: Fence enrichment writes after a project switch
acceptance: Deferred enrichment resolved after a switch performs no obsolete card or image writes.

title: Make same-image back relinking refcount-neutral
acceptance: Repeating assignment of the existing back image leaves its refCount unchanged in a focused regression.

title: Remove duplicate back-reference reservation from Scryfall conversion
acceptance: Quantity-one and quantity-four converter fixtures have one counted reference per linked back after linking.

title: Remove duplicate back-reference reservation from direct DFC import
acceptance: Direct MPC/Scryfall-back fallback fixtures count only actual linked backs for each imported quantity.

title: Remove duplicate reservation from explicit-back direct import
acceptance: Explicit-back imports retain exactly one image reference per linked card with a focused test.

title: Scope duplicate ordering reads to the source project
acceptance: Duplicating in A leaves B's order and fields byte-identical in a shared-name two-project fixture.

title: Reject mixed-project UUID inputs to bulk duplicate
acceptance: A mixed-project request fails before writes while a same-project request succeeds.

title: Restrict shared-image bleed mutation targets by project
acceptance: A bleed edit on a shared image in A cannot change the referencing card in B.

title: Restrict same-name bleed selection to the editor project
acceptance: Apply-to-named selection supplies only same-project UUIDs for names shared across projects.

title: Scope editor Apply to All to the captured project
acceptance: Apply to All in A writes overrides and schedules pre-renders only for A; B is unchanged.

title: Reject cross-project selections in editor bulk apply
acceptance: A selected UUID from another project is rejected before the bulk override transaction writes anything.

title: Add a compound project-order Dexie index
acceptance: A schema-upgrade fixture retains existing cards and exposes a usable projectId plus order index.

title: Use a project-local maximum order in addCards
acceptance: Adding to A ignores B's distant order values and preserves explicit incoming order values.

title: Use a project-local maximum order in stream imports
acceptance: Stream placeholders append within their own project without reading another project's order space.

title: Serialize append-order reservation with card insertion
acceptance: Two concurrent same-project appends have deterministic noncolliding front order slots while linked backs retain intended order.

title: Preserve id and oracle_id in cached-card projection
acceptance: A SQL-row conversion regression retains both identity fields and existing payload fields unchanged.

title: Verify cached token lookup preserves oracle resolution
acceptance: A cache-hit fixture follows oracle identity to the intended latest token print without changing the network-path contract.

title: Make direct import completion await resolution writes
acceptance: A deferred direct import does not call onComplete until metadata/image/link persistence settles; placeholders remain immediate.

title: Pass import cancellation through direct resolver requests
acceptance: The direct path receives and forwards the operation AbortSignal to cancellable resolution requests.

title: Fence direct-import persistence after cancellation
acceptance: Cancel or clear after placeholders prevents late card/image/refcount writes when deferred resolution returns.

title: Fence direct-import persistence after project changes
acceptance: A direct import started in A cannot mutate obsolete targets after the active project changes.

title: Track an image processor's active task per worker
acceptance: Dispatch and settle transitions maintain exactly one owned active task per busy worker with a focused worker mock.

title: Reject active processing promises on cancelAll
acceptance: Cancelling a dispatched task rejects once, empties active ownership and returns activity count to zero.

title: Settle queued and active promises on destroy
acceptance: Destroy rejects all unfinished tasks exactly once and leaves no queue, active task or worker ownership.

title: Verify image-processing hook cleanup after active cancellation
acceptance: A hook regression reaches finally and revokes its owned URL when a dispatched worker is cancelled.

title: Await the editor's single-card apply callback
acceptance: A rejected single-card mutation retains the modal with an error; successful persistence closes it only afterward.

title: Await the editor's selected-card apply callback
acceptance: Selected-card apply exposes pending/error state and does not close before its callback settles.

title: Await the editor's all-card apply callback
acceptance: All-card apply exposes pending/error state and closes only after successful project-scoped persistence.

title: Fence artwork preview search responses by operation generation
acceptance: An older automatic search resolving after a newer search cannot set preview data or auto-apply its first print.

title: Fence Scryfall artwork selection writes by target and generation
acceptance: An older Scryfall selection resolving after a newer intent/navigation cannot write artwork, links or success UI.

title: Fence MPC artwork selection writes by target and generation
acceptance: An older MPC selection resolving after a newer intent/navigation cannot write artwork, links or success UI.

title: Accept AbortSignal in the MPC search transport
acceptance: Transport forwards the supplied signal and propagates cancellation without caching a partial result.

title: Fence MPC hook results and loading state by request generation
acceptance: Reverse-completing A/B queries leave only B's results and loading state; unmount aborts the current request.

title: Coalesce identical in-flight MPC query requests
acceptance: Concurrent identical misses use one transport request and fan out the same result without caching failures.

title: Isolate cancellation between coalesced MPC subscribers
acceptance: Cancelling one subscriber does not abort another; the transport aborts when all subscribers cancel.

title: Cancel delayed multi-drag work on teardown
acceptance: Unmount/cancel with pending drag timers produces no late state update and leaves zero owned timers.

title: Add a concurrency-one direct-Scryfall request broker
acceptance: Fake-clock tests show one active request, at least 100ms dispatch spacing, and release after rejection; broker has no callers yet.

title: Route catalog requests through the direct-Scryfall broker
acceptance: Catalog refresh no longer dispatches direct requests in parallel and retains all expected catalog results.

title: Route Scryfall router fallbacks through the shared broker
acceptance: All physical direct requests in scryfallRouter use the broker, including retry dispatches; microservice calls remain separate.

title: Route paged-card direct requests through the shared broker
acceptance: getCardImagesPaged direct fetch/retry dispatches obey the shared lease and preserve batching behavior.

title: Route token direct requests through the shared broker
acceptance: Token lookup direct calls use the broker and retain lookup fallback order.

title: Route bulk-metadata requests through the shared broker
acceptance: Bulk metadata acquisition obeys the same direct-request dispatch policy without serializing unrelated file processing.

title: Verify cross-caller Scryfall rate spacing
acceptance: One deterministic test mixes catalog/router/token/bulk/enrichment requests and proves one active direct request and minimum spacing.

title: Define the supported image-proxy origin policy
acceptance: A checked-in policy names required HTTPS providers and any intentional fixed local route; arbitrary local paths are explicitly forbidden.

title: Reject image-proxy URLs outside the parsed origin policy
acceptance: URL-parser fixtures cover scheme, userinfo, port, host and relative-path rejection before transport invocation.

title: Reject private resolved addresses at proxy connection time
acceptance: Connection-policy tests reject loopback, link-local, private and mapped-address targets, including DNS changes after validation.

title: Enforce image-proxy policy on every redirect hop
acceptance: A redirect to a disallowed origin/address causes no forbidden connection; allowed bounded redirects still work.

title: Stream proxy downloads with a per-response byte cap
acceptance: An oversized upstream response aborts before full buffering and removes its partial temp file; valid images succeed.

title: Bind desktop-started Express to loopback explicitly
acceptance: Desktop launch binds loopback while configured server deployment retains an explicit host option; a focused bind test proves both.

title: Document the private-route authorization contract
acceptance: An ADR specifies desktop credential bootstrap, server authentication, project ownership and public-share exclusions with a route matrix; no runtime implementation in this task.

title: Add a private-route authentication middleware seam
acceptance: Middleware rejects absent/invalid credentials and accepts a configured valid identity in focused tests; no routes are migrated yet.

title: Create a per-launch desktop API credential
acceptance: Desktop startup generates an unguessable ephemeral credential and installs it in the local server verifier without logging or persisting it.

title: Expose desktop API authentication through an allowlisted preload method
acceptance: Only the trusted renderer bootstrap can obtain the per-launch API credential; the IPC handler rejects an unexpected sender.

title: Attach configured authentication in the private client transport
acceptance: Private API requests use the configured desktop/server identity and public provider requests never receive that credential.

title: Wire backup calls through the authenticated private transport
acceptance: Backup list/read/write/delete helpers use the private transport and preserve authorized auto-backup behavior.

title: Wire preference calls through the authenticated private transport
acceptance: Preference helper requests use the private transport without leaking the credential to other origins.

title: Wire calibration calls through the authenticated private transport
acceptance: Calibration helpers preserve upload/abort behavior while authenticated calls succeed and missing identity produces an explicit error.

title: Enforce authentication on backup routes
acceptance: Unauthenticated backup list/read/write/delete calls fail before data access; authenticated calls reach the existing handlers.

title: Enforce owner scope on backup record operations
acceptance: An authenticated owner cannot enumerate/read/overwrite/delete another owner's backups; own backup operations succeed.

title: Protect preference routes with the private-route boundary
acceptance: Preference read/write requests require the configured authenticated scope and reject cross-scope access.

title: Protect calibration routes with the private-route boundary
acceptance: Unauthenticated requests cannot list/mutate profiles or start calibration subprocess work.

title: Protect operational metrics with the private-route boundary
acceptance: Private metrics reject unauthenticated requests without changing intentionally public shallow health checks.

title: Bound normalized import request cardinality and fields
acceptance: Oversized lists/strings and malformed fields are rejected before stream/metadata work; valid boundary-size input succeeds.

title: Batch deduplicated token identifier lookups
acceptance: Duplicate-heavy token input uses supported collection batches and preserves input-to-result mapping before fallback.

title: Cancel stream resolution when its client disconnects
acceptance: A disconnected SSE request stops queued resolution work and releases its owned resources without affecting another stream.

title: Enforce a bounded SSE operation deadline
acceptance: A hung resolver ends with a documented timeout outcome and releases the connection; normal completion stays ordered and uncompressed.

title: Implement the shared client's configured request timeout
acceptance: Configured deadline aborts both response wait and body consumption; caller AbortSignal still takes precedence when earlier.

title: Coalesce concurrent microservice health probes
acceptance: Concurrent health callers share one in-flight probe; a rejection clears the entry so the next request can recover.

title: Add short-lived health-status caching with explicit expiry
acceptance: A fresh result avoids repeated probes, an expired result rechecks, and a prior failure does not prevent later recovery.

title: Move effect decode behind bounded queue admission
acceptance: Deferred decode tests prove no bitmap/canvas/ImageData allocation occurs until a job owns an admission slot.

title: Coalesce queued and active equivalent effect renditions
acceptance: Cards sharing image revision, DPI and canonical overrides produce one render with per-card completion delivery.

title: Fence effect cache persistence against superseded generations
acceptance: An obsolete render may settle but cannot replace the cache entry for a newer rendition generation.

title: Document an export working-set budget from a bounded measurement
acceptance: A repository-local probe/report records representative page/card/PDF working-set estimates and selects conservative byte/page/concurrency limits; distinguish measured RSS from estimates.

title: Cap PDF worker count using the export surface budget
acceptance: Given page/card dimensions, worker admission stays within the chosen conservative budget rather than hardwareConcurrency alone.

title: Send page-scoped image maps to PDF workers
acceptance: A page job includes only referenced front/back image IDs and produces unchanged page content in a focused payload test.

title: Bound worker canvasCache with byte-accounted eviction
acceptance: An over-budget sequence evicts least-recently-used canvases and frees owned surfaces without evicting an active render.

title: Add byte-budget admission to the effect queue
acceptance: Mixed-size effects cannot exceed the configured decoded-surface budget even when worker slots remain available.

title: Probe shared-context export overlap in a real browser
acceptance: A deterministic local browser probe alternates dimensions/colors and verifies actual output pixels; evidence states whether snapshot overlap is safe, unsafe or blocked, without assuming mock semantics.

title: Record the context lease decision from the overlap probe
acceptance: A decision document selects existing snapshot ownership, serialization or a bounded pool from R09 evidence and names any required atomic implementation follow-ups; no speculative mutex is added.

title: Reuse immutable shader pipeline resources per GL context
acceptance: Two renders on one context compile/link the immutable pipeline once; context invalidation deletes exactly the resources it owns.

title: Enforce bounded eviction for explicit-DPI effect writes
acceptance: Explicit-DPI setter participates in byte-accounted eviction and reports quota errors without corrupting an existing entry.

title: Route PDF effect-cache writes through the shared cache policy
acceptance: PDF writes no longer duplicate unrestricted puts; an over-budget test uses the shared enforcement behavior.

title: Settle ZIP cache-write outcomes at export cleanup
acceptance: Successful ZIP delivery remains successful when optional caching fails, but cache failure is surfaced and owned writes settle at cleanup.

title: Apply a measured per-upload calibration PDF cap
acceptance: Configured boundary accepts supported PDFs and rejects oversize input before full temp allocation; chosen cap is justified by R04 rather than blindly using 10 GiB.

title: Bound aggregate calibration temporary-file bytes
acceptance: Concurrent uploads exceeding aggregate quota are rejected and reservations release on success/error/abort.

title: Remove calibration upload files on disconnect
acceptance: Interrupted multipart uploads remove their owned partial files and release resource reservations without deleting another request's files.

title: Bound simultaneous calibration subprocesses
acceptance: A configured queue limit caps active Python processes; cancellation releases queued work and no request exceeds its deadline.

title: Bound aggregate proxy-download memory and temporary bytes
acceptance: Concurrent image responses cannot exceed configured resource reservations; abort/error paths release them exactly once.

title: Index linked-back share lookups by UUID
acceptance: DFC-heavy fixtures preserve exact serialized ordering/indices while lookup operation counts grow linearly with cards.

title: Index original multi-drag orders by UUID
acceptance: Exact undo adjustments match existing semantics and one-pass lookup counts replace nested finds.

title: Merge image reference deltas in a keyed map
acceptance: Swap/shared/no-op fixtures produce exact refcounts and an O(images plus links) operation count without scanning a growing updates array.

title: Reuse one art-crop SSIM result for recommendation layers
acceptance: Counting comparator runs once per eligible candidate and all ranking layers retain expected output/fallback behavior.

title: Bulk-read normalized MPC cache keys
acceptance: A duplicate-heavy query batch performs one bulk read and preserves original-query mapping and cache hits.

title: Bulk-write validated MPC batch cache results
acceptance: One transaction bulk-writes successful results with existing normalization and no partial malformed entries.

title: Preassign ZIP filenames in input order
acceptance: Reverse-completing duplicate-name render tasks retain deterministic suffixes and existing index prefixes.

title: Insert prepared ZIP entries in input order
acceptance: Bounded parallel preparation resolves in arbitrary order but archive insertion order equals source order.

title: Subscribe PageView to source-bleed setting primitives
acceptance: Changing each source-mode/amount setting at unchanged global bleed width updates layout and drag-overlay geometry.

title: Move drag-overlay object URLs into effect ownership
acceptance: Replacing a same-ID blob refreshes its URL; removal and unmount revoke every owned URL exactly once; render remains side-effect free.

title: Replace Pixi blob-size freshness with rendition identity
acceptance: Distinct same-size blobs for one image ID recreate the texture and revoke the prior URL at safe replacement.

title: Correct dormant image-cache rendition keys
acceptance: A hook fixture with two cards sharing one image but different overrides retains separate renditions and detects same-size replacement; no production adoption is added.

title: Preserve CardGrid column width when callers pass style
acceptance: cardSize plus an unrelated caller background style retains both properties in a focused component test.

title: Replace proxy fixed-sleep deduplication with an in-flight promise
acceptance: Many concurrent identical misses perform one upstream request and all callers observe a completed file or shared failure.

title: Publish proxy cache files by atomic rename
acceptance: Readers never receive partial content; failed write/rename leaves no corrupt final entry or orphan owned temp file.

title: Record incremental image-cache size and access metadata
acceptance: Serve/write paths update a keyed metadata record with correct size/access values; startup reconciliation remains explicit.

title: Evict image cache in bounded metadata-driven batches
acceptance: Steady-state eviction avoids directory-wide stat/sort and removes oldest eligible entries while respecting the configured cap.

title: Replace backup length fingerprint with a canonical content digest
acceptance: Reorder, override, link/artwork and equal-length settings changes each alter the digest; unchanged state does not.

title: Retain dirty backup work skipped by rate or in-flight guards
acceptance: A change during an active backup or minimum interval schedules one later backup of the newest state rather than disappearing.

title: Validate backup project and card records before writes
acceptance: Missing/null project, malformed card fields and invalid settings fail before any database write.

title: Validate backup UUID and linked-face consistency
acceptance: Duplicate UUIDs and dangling or invalid reciprocal links fail before import mutation; valid links still remap correctly.

title: Validate backup image encoding and decoded-size limits
acceptance: Invalid base64, missing image collection and over-budget decoded content fail before Blob allocation/persistence.

title: Include imported images in the project import transaction
acceptance: A mid-import failure rolls back images, project and cards together while preserving pre-existing deduplicated images.

title: Batch backup image existence reads and writes
acceptance: Import uses bulk image operations instead of serialized per-image get/put without changing transaction or deduplication semantics.

title: Atomically replace Python profile TOML files
acceptance: A write failure preserves the previous valid file and readers observe complete old/new TOML, never truncated output.

title: Lock Python profile read-modify-write across processes
acceptance: Two barrier-controlled concurrent mutations retain both changes and release the lock on exceptions.

title: Reject unsupported calibration profile metadata explicitly
acceptance: Unsupported paper_size or duplex_mode is rejected before persistence; supported metadata round-trips exactly with no silent replacement.

title: Reject non-finite calibration offsets at the public boundary
acceptance: Library and CLI reject NaN and positive/negative infinity before storage or PDF transformation.

title: Extract a Node-safe preference-fixture validator
acceptance: A shared parser validates supported versions, cases and candidates without DOM dependencies and preserves existing valid fixtures.

title: Validate normalized preference promotion input before replacement
acceptance: Malformed versioned/unversioned inputs fail with explicit errors and leave destination bytes unchanged.

title: Publish promoted preference fixtures atomically
acceptance: A simulated write/rename failure preserves the original fixture and removes only the operation's temporary file.

title: Support grouped-duplex offsets in the Python transform
acceptance: A real small PDF fixture applies front offsets to the first group and back offsets to the second while preserving page order.

title: Expose grouped-duplex mode in the calibration route contract
acceptance: Validated front-page-count/order parameters reach the CLI; invalid ranges fail before spawning.

title: Send grouped-duplex metadata from the calibration client
acceptance: Client helper forwards grouping information with existing PDF upload and preserves cancellation/error behavior.

title: Remove client interleave-regroup copies for grouped calibration
acceptance: Export uses the grouped transform contract directly and a small PDF test proves order/offset equivalence with previous behavior.

title: Make preference seed harvesting abortable
acceptance: Cancellation stops further seed transport admission and propagates an abort outcome without partial profile publication.

title: Bound concurrent independent MPC seed searches
acceptance: Seed harvesting overlaps only up to the explicit MPC limit and returns deterministic seed order; direct Scryfall policy is untouched.

title: Bound visual-profile image decoding with cancellation
acceptance: Deferred decode tests prove capped active buffers and no new admission after abort.

title: Cache immutable preference contexts by complete input version
acceptance: Identical dataset/source/provider/algorithm versions share one in-flight context; changed keys invalidate it and failures do not poison cache.

title: Reuse the preference context in the upgrade modal
acceptance: Repeated/open concurrent upgrade consumers reuse one context and closing a modal cancels only its subscription.

title: Reuse the preference context in the calibration modal
acceptance: Calibration bootstrap consumes the same keyed context and close prevents stale state writes.

title: Hoist seed-profile construction out of held-out evaluation
acceptance: A multi-case evaluation builds seed profiles once while each fold trains independently; predictions match a deterministic baseline.

title: Own and cancel the delayed microservice restart timer
acceptance: Stop during a pending restart delay prevents a later spawn and leaves no restart timer.

title: Clear the previous health interval before replacement
acceptance: Repeated healthy-crash-restart cycles retain one health interval and stop clears it.

title: Coalesce concurrent microservice start callers
acceptance: Concurrent start calls share one readiness promise and do not report ready before the child health check succeeds.

title: Handle child spawn errors as a supervised failure
acceptance: Spawn error rejects readiness and cleans process ownership without an unhandled child error event.

title: Reset restart budget only after a stability interval
acceptance: Repeated short-lived healthy starts exhaust the configured restart budget; a sufficiently stable run resets it in fake-clock tests.

title: Probe HTTP identity and readiness instead of TCP-open
acceptance: Wrong listener, HTTP 503 and hung response fail readiness; expected healthy identity succeeds within the deadline.

title: Show a loading window before service readiness completes
acceptance: A delayed service-start fixture displays the shell early and prevents dependent actions until readiness is known.

title: Block initial Electron quit until owned shutdown settles
acceptance: Quit is prevented once, bounded stop settles, and guarded reentry quits; repeated quit/update paths do not recurse.

title: Return disposers from allowlisted IPC subscriptions
acceptance: Each subscription removes exactly its own wrapper; repeated dispose is safe and raw ipcRenderer remains private.

title: Dispose renderer updater subscriptions on effect cleanup
acceptance: Repeated mount/unmount and StrictMode replay retain one listener while mounted and zero afterward.

title: Dispose the App About subscription on effect cleanup
acceptance: App teardown removes its IPC listener as well as the DOM listener with no duplicate delivery after remount.

title: Serialize atomic asynchronous Electron settings writes
acceptance: Concurrent settings updates retain both values, failed writes preserve the last complete JSON, and IPC uses no synchronous settings I/O.

title: Resolve the development binary directory from import.meta.url
acceptance: An emitted-ESM path fixture resolves the intended development binary without a CommonJS global.

title: Probe the built preload bridge in sandboxed Electron
acceptance: A real-runtime smoke records whether the built allowlisted bridge loads and exposes expected methods; blocked runtime is reported honestly.

title: Record the preload compatibility disposition
acceptance: Document verified compatibility or a narrowly specified bundling fix based on E14; do not disable context isolation or enable renderer Node integration.

title: Build shared-client output once before parallel consumers
acceptance: An aggregate-build fixture delays shared output creation and proves no client/server consumer starts until complete output exists.

title: Remove destructive shared rebuild from aggregate server consumption
acceptance: Aggregate server invocation does not delete/rebuild shared dist while client reads it; standalone server build still establishes its prerequisite.

title: Invalidate shared-build readiness when source changes
acceptance: A changed shared source with existing dist triggers a current artifact build rather than passing an existence-only check.

title: Separate clean server builds from incremental builds
acceptance: Normal unchanged rebuild retains tsbuildinfo; explicit clean rebuild removes stale artifacts and deleted-source output is handled.

title: Add an explicit client TypeScript validation command
acceptance: A deliberate type-error fixture fails the command even if Vite transpilation would succeed; no production source errors are repaired in this task.

title: Run client type validation from release validation
acceptance: A failing typecheck stops release validation before promotion and cannot be reported as passed or silently skipped.

title: Run component builds from release validation
acceptance: Required client/server/Electron builds execute via the corrected dependency graph and any failure blocks release.

title: Run required component test gates from release validation
acceptance: A stub failure in each configured test gate blocks release; an explicit override is labeled skipped, not passed.

title: Overlap independent release validation gates safely
acceptance: Independent gates run with bounded concurrency while prerequisite-consuming gates remain ordered and fail closed.

title: Send release-note prompt through child stdin without a shell
acceptance: Dollar/backtick/quote/newline fixtures reach a local stub stdin literally and cause no shell evaluation.

title: Pin and configure the optional release-note executable
acceptance: Release-note generation uses a declared executable/version and an offline/manual fallback instead of unpinned network installation.

title: Drain release-note stderr with bounded capture
acceptance: A local stub producing large stderr cannot deadlock generation and retained diagnostic output respects a cap.

title: Terminate the release-note process tree on timeout
acceptance: A stub descendant exits after timeout/cancel and the release path settles once with manual fallback available.

title: Emit a microservice build artifact manifest
acceptance: Manifest records actual binary path/platform/profile from supported overrides and rejects missing output before success.

title: Resolve packaged microservice inputs from the artifact manifest
acceptance: Alternate target directories cannot silently package a stale sibling release binary; incompatible platform/profile is rejected.

title: Resolve the development microservice path from the artifact manifest
acceptance: Development launch selects the manifest's existing compatible binary rather than ignoring build-directory overrides.

title: Run independent Rust and JS builds before a packaging join
acceptance: Bounded parallel prerequisites must both succeed before packaging consumes their complete artifacts.

title: Set calibration venv runner defaults in the server image
acceptance: A standalone-image configuration check resolves the venv executable and Python without Compose-only environment variables.

title: Lock the calibration runtime Python dependency set
acceptance: A committed lock/constraints artifact records reproducible versions and hashes or documented system-package pinning for all runtime dependencies.

title: Install the locked Python runtime without uncontrolled pip upgrades
acceptance: Docker build consumes the lock, uses the chosen system/venv policy and no longer upgrades pip arbitrarily.

title: Verify calibration commands in the standalone built image
acceptance: A bounded image smoke lists profiles and generates/transforms a small valid PDF without Compose; resolved package versions are recorded.

title: Record operation-count scaling for the linear lookup fixes
acceptance: Repository-local evidence compares N and scaled N for all three fixed lookup kernels with identical outputs; no invented wall-time speedup claims.

title: Record a bounded high-DPI export resource probe
acceptance: A representative export records actual completion/order and peak resource observations against configured budgets; blocked browser/native paths are explicit.

title: Record an Electron lifecycle smoke on built artifacts
acceptance: Real startup/bridge/shutdown evidence is bound to the tested commit and verifies no retained owned child after quit, or clearly reports a blocker.

title: Move live Scryfall unit-test probes into a serialized contract gate
acceptance: Rarity/color unit tests no longer make ungoverned live calls; an explicit opt-in contract gate retains meaningful assertions and FIFO policy.

title: Add a real small-PDF calibration package smoke
acceptance: A real pypdf fixture validates page count/order and finite-offset transform through the public library instead of only mocked classes.

title: Correct build-speed documentation for clean versus incremental commands
acceptance: Documented commands match B04 behavior and separate cold/warm evidence without repeating obsolete incremental claims.

title: Mark historical architecture reviews as non-current guidance
acceptance: Historical reviews point to current bundled/local-client/self-hosted decisions and no longer present GitHub Actions or registry migration as current instructions.

title: Document evidence limits for remaining runtime hypotheses
acceptance: The review follow-up index links actual G02/E12 dispositions, distinguishing reproduced, disproved and blocked outcomes with any necessary new leaf tasks identified.

title: Centralize repeated calibration CLI error formatting
acceptance: One narrow error adapter preserves existing command messages/exit codes and does not catch KeyboardInterrupt or SystemExit.

title: Consolidate duplicate bounded-limiter mechanics
acceptance: Image and token callers use one tested limiter implementation with distinct explicit policies; direct Scryfall still uses concurrency one.
